@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 The Framework helps organizations manage risks to individuals, organizations, and society associated with AI.
+A new Generative AI Profile has been published, providing risk guidance specific to generative AI systems including disclosure of AI-generated content.

--- 
+++ 
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 This standard specifies requirements for establishing an AI management system.
+Clause 6.1.4 has been revised to require documented risk assessments prior to deployment of any AI system that makes automated decisions affecting individuals.

--- 
+++ 
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-Control AC-2 has been updated to clarify account review procedures.
+Control AC-2 has been updated to clarify account review procedures and timelines.

--- 
+++ 
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 Providers of general-purpose AI models must comply with transparency obligations.
+Guidance has been added clarifying that providers must disclose the training data summary and any known limitations of the model to downstream deployers.
